nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel

avis.titre: Worth the money! Give it a try
avis.texte: It has taken me about 1 yr. to get through the bottle. I started off by using it once a day and I slowly incorporated it daily. I noticed minor peeling and sensitivity once I began using it 2x/wk. This serum has more of a toner consistency, it's watery and not gel like nor serumy. To me, it has no smell. I like that it comes in a dropper for easy application. This product is part of my morning routine. First, I use the Olay vitamin c brightening cleanser, I leave it on my face while I brush my teeth and then rinse. Second, I will go in with this Kiehl's serum. Third, the Glow Recipe cloudberry toner. Fourth, the Drunk Elephant Bouncy Brightfacial. Finally, sunscreen. With consistency, this Kiehl's product really works, and I would repurchase it, but it is not in the budget. I really recommend it!

I have sensitive skin prone to dryness but also oiliness in certain parts of my face, along with acne mostly focused on my nose and forehead. I haven't noticed much of a difference yet, but my skin does seem a bit less dull. I am pleased that this product did not break out my skin or cause any allergic reactions. I haven't been using it for long so I don't have results yet, but I have high hopes for it.
Im trying to figure out all these great reviews. This product does nothing. Went through a whole bottle with no difference in skin. What a waste of fifty dollars.

I just ordered this product for the first time and have noticed a significant difference after only a couple of days. I'm seeing a smoother, finer, brighter skin tone and I like what I see. I will make this part of my permanent skin care plan.
Amazingly gentle serum that provides quick results. I'm glad I decided to pick this up on a whim. It has replaced my previous brand.

Discovering Kiehl's Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel Serum was a game-changer for my skincare routine. It's not just a product; it's a revelation. With each application, my skin transforms into a canvas of glassy smooth perfection, revealing a luminosity that's truly captivating. Blemishes? They're a thing of the past, thanks to this serum's precision in tackling imperfections, leaving my complexion flawlessly smooth. Uneven skin tone? Not anymore. This serum works like a charm, restoring balance and creating a masterpiece of radiance. But it's not just about the surface; this serum goes deep, nurturing my skin from within, making it stronger and more resilient with every use. I can confidently say I'm not just a fan – I'm a devotee. Kiehl's has earned its place in my skincare collection as a trusted brand that delivers results. In summary, if you're ready to unveil the radiance within, Kiehl's Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel Serum is a must-try. Trust me, your skin will thank you.

Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel has become one of my favorite serums and is now a staple in my skin care routine. One little bottle comes packed with 3 very powerful acids (Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, and Gluconolactone) along with super-berry extracts such as Acai, Maqui, and Goji all of which are amazing for your skin and known for their antioxidant properties! All of these ingredients combined help to achieve a nice, radiant and healthy glow without any kind of irritation or leaving your skin feel too tight and overly dried out. I also absolutely love the fact that it's designed for daily use unlike other acidic serums I've tried and the glass tincture bottle makes it very easy to use or travel with (a huge bonus in my opinion). Overall, I would most definitely recommend this serum to a friend and will be buying it again too without a doubt!

My skin has been severly scarred and broken out from stress acne this showed me almost immediate results i literally saw improvement in my face over night! Thank you for this magic acne killing serum!

This product was recommended to me after I did the skin exam at their Boston location— it was recommended because I have a lot of texture/dry skin on my nose and omg… it has made my complexion so much more even and radiant. After the first couple uses I noticed a huge difference in my skin's texture. Definitely would recommend this product for anyone looking for an easy extra step to a cleanser and moisturizer!

Amazing! I can't believe how smooth my skin is. And how healthy it is. All my skincare products are Kiehls and this has been an amazing addition to my routine. Adding this has given me the confidence to not wear foundation.
I like the way this made my skin look more radiant. I continued to have acne while using it, but no more than usual. It did reduce my forehead wrinkles.
use this in the morning and evening around 3 times a week. Great for getting the dry skin off from the cold winter weather. Makes my skin clean, smooth and shiny.
I love how my skin looks! I'm obsessed with the results!! My skin texture has been disappearing after each use!!

my skin can be sensitive at times & i have a lot of redness so i was a bit nervous to try this peel! to my pleasant surprise though this product is very gentle! my skin was left feeling very soft & a bit brighter! It also seems to be helping my skins texture, so i look forward to further results!
My skin has never looked better. I have been using this peel weekly and it has helped my skin look younger and my acne scarring is almost gone completely.
you received the product/service for free After a few weeks of use , less texture visible on n my face

avis.titre: Soft and gentle in your skin
avis.texte: I always like to exfoliate my skin two times a week and I prefer the químical exfoliation and this one has really good ingredients to exfoliate your skin and gentle I been see my skin soft and some of my fats spot look more small and my skin is more bright y I really like the result and the brand I know they have really good skin care products

Don't let the name "triple acid peel" scare you. I thought that it would be too harsh, but once I applied and I felt a tightening in my skin. It doesn't irritate my skin. I love the way it glides on and the way my skin absorbed the solution.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I used this product once daily for several weeks. I immediately noticed a much smoother skin tone. After the first week, I began to notice an improvement with some of my fine lines. After two weeks I noticed an overall improvement with my skins appearance and texture.

I started with this product and followed up with my regular moisturizers. I feel like even after the first use I saw a decrease in the fine lines around my eyes and forehead. The only thing that was a challenge was reading the information on the bottle itself as it was clear and the print was very small and not easy to see.
This helped my skin look so great the next day! After using this for a few weeks, my pores are smaller and my skin is very soft. I will definitely be keeping this in my skincare routine.
Pros: did not burn, skin felt softer and smoother right after using Cons: skin felt sensitive the day after and i was worried to stay in the sun, some skin purging (small acne)

I've used this 3 weeks every night. I started with large pores and pigmentation. I did notice smaller pores and some smoothness. I will keep using and hopefully see a difference in pigmentation and texture.
I love it! My skin became so soft the next morning. I'd suggest starting off by using it 2-3 times a week for sensitive skin. Just in case your sensitive skin can't handle it.

avis.titre: Definitely will be added to my permanent daily skin routine!
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about a month, and within the short time period I've seen so many great results. I've had multiple people come up to me to complement my skin and specifically my pores and how small they are - all thanks to this product! I feel as though my skin is looking younger and I can see the beginning signs of significant more even skin tone on my face. Great product!

I used this product at night, it can be used twice a day but I worry about sun sensitivity. It does make your skin softer in the mornings and helps to remove your dead skin! I am prone to dry skin when using products like this was but worked well for my skin under my night time moisturizer.

avis.titre: A little too harsh for me
avis.texte: Left my sensitive skin a bit more red than I would have thought.

My too-visible pores have always bothered me, and this is the first product I've tried that actually works! After using every other day for 2 weeks, my pores were much less visible and my girlfriends asked me what I was using because my skin looked so great. Excited to see the results as I continue using this product.
I haven't used this product long enough to see differences in my skin texture, but I have enjoyed the product in my skincare routine and it has not caused any sensitivity.

This product works really well and is gentle enough to use twice a day without irritation. I have noticed a change with my pores and fine lines. Would recommend using this with the Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum. I would recommend this to friends or family.

I wanted to love this. It made my skin feel so nice after using it a few times. Unfortunately having it on my face irritated my eyes even though I didn't use it anywhere near them. It's great if you don't have a bunch of sensitivities like I do.

avis.titre: It leaves my skin feeling and looking smooth
avis.texte: I use this a few times a week usually at nights, and I've been seeing a significant difference in my skin texture. It looks smoother and healthier. I've also noticed improvement on my pore apperance looking much smaller and my line lines reduced. Best part about this acid peel is, it doesn't burn or sting and it's gentle on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: A gentle peel from the comfort of your own home
avis.texte: Thank you to Kiehl's who gifted me this product to try. The packaging has a high end feel. The texture is a little watery, so I was skeptical. But a little goes a long way. There is no sting when you apply it, but you can feel the sensation of it working. This product has a higher acid % than many OTC- so patch test first. It was great on my nose, chin and cheeks, but the thinner more sensitive skin on my forehead broke out a little so I stopped using it on that area. I noticed smaller pores and fantastic skin turnover. It also lightened an area with some sun damage. My skin looked fresh & healthy- brighter and less dull from the harsh new england winter..

I use this product in the morning. It says you can use it twice a day. Maybe I should've. I like the product. It goes on smoothly and doesn't smell bad. I can wear under my makeup and it's fine. I don't know if I haven't been using it for long enough but I haven't seen much difference with it yet. I would recommend using twice a day.

Kiehls is a go-to brand for me so when I decided to add a gentle peel to my routine I gave this a try. I really like the way my skin feels after I use it - it just feels and looks more even. I will definitely repurchase.
I feel has this has improved my texture of my skin over the last couple weeks and I feel like it makes my moisturizer really sink in! So far loving the results

I've been in love with this peel since I received it. I have sensitive skin and acids can sometimes make my skin bright red and burn. I've had no issue with this peel and it makes my skin feel so soft the morning after I use it.

Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Daily Re-texturizing Triple Acid Peel helped fade my dark spots (hyperpigmentation). It gave me a more even skin tone and brighter-looking skin. It is gentle on the skin and absorbs quickly. It did not cause any dryness or irritations like some acid peels. It is easy to use with the dropper application.

I use this product twice a day and follow up my routine with sunscreen. This product absorbs immediately into my skin. There is no burn and yields quality results. I feel I present as more alert when taking care of my skin with this product.

I received this product to use along with Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide and all I can say is WOW!! There was an instant difference in my skin the next morning. I've faithfully used it since receipt and will definitely repurchase. Since I've used them together I can really say how the peel works alone. Together, they're a POWERHOUSE!

I received a sample from Kiehl's to review, and I was hooked from the first use. This daily peel is strong enough to leave behind soft, smooth skin but also gentle enough to be used daily without any irritation. I have a tendency to have dry, flaky patches even with heavy moisturizers, but this daily peel serum improved that almost 100%. My bare skin is brighter and my pores are smaller. I'm very impressed and will continue to use this product!

I have been using this product every other day (alternating with vitamin C serum) for the last 3.5 weeks. It's is really gentle and my skin has no bad reactions but I did notice a little purge when I first started. My skin is clearing up and feels nice and smooth to touch. I hope with continued use that. The illness in my skin will fade and the texture will even out more. Because it is so gentle I am going to try to incorporate it into my routine every morning with my vitamin C serum. It hasn't pilled which is a huge plus. Kiehl's gifted me this product for my honest review.
I really liked this triple acid that really treats the skin without irritating it, it didn't bother or burn my skin, and it still brings super satisfactory results.

I was nervous starting this because most peels are harsh on the face when using weekly. I applied this every day and had no stinging or burning. As usual this brand exceeded my expectations. My skin seems smoother and more even. My only complaint is the dropper and glass bottle. The directions say to apply with cotton ball and the dropper is not needed and gets in the way.

avis.titre: I would buy this again because it's amazing
avis.texte: I use this product every morning and it makes the dry spots on my face clear up. I never thought I would find anything to help out my dry patches but this product is very amazing

avis.titre: A good active for my face
avis.texte: I used this after washing my face at night. I feel like this kept my skin clear without overdrying. My skin texture can sometimes feel rough and this helped exfoliate me without being harsh on my skin. The only thing I would say is that because this is like a toner in texture that you apply via cotton pad, the bottle doesn't last particularly long. It's pretty small for that. But the formula is good.

I started using Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel twice a day and apply it with my fingers. I honestly thought my skin would get a negative reaction from it or some slight irritation, but it was so gentle on my skin. After the first week of use I noticed not only my skin feeling softer but hydrated as well. I've been using it constantly since and I am not disappointed in the results. My face texture has improved, and my skin tone has evened out.
Where I try to not use peels too much (I use multiple acids so I dont want to overdo it) but I liked this peel!

I followed the product directions precisely, using cotton rounds for application. Initially skeptical due to the term "acid peel," I was pleasantly surprised by its gentleness. It didn't provoke any adverse reactions and left my skin feeling remarkably soft while improving its texture. I've truly been enjoying the Clearly Corrective™ Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel. Its lightweight, smooth texture doesn't cause breakouts and leaves my skin bright and radiant with no discernible scent. Notably, it has noticeably improved the texture on my forehead.

avis.titre: I would definitely recommend and buy this product
avis.texte: Kiehl's new acid peel is gentle and safe to use daily. The tri-acid peel formulation of alpha, beta and poly hydroxy acids work to diminish the appearance of pores, smooth skin texture, and brighten skin. I uses this product just as the directions stated. I used the cotton rounds to apply it. I will say I was skeptical at first , anything with the words acid and peel always make me a little nervous. But this product is very gentle! It didn't cause me any adverse reactions. Left my skin feeling very soft. It also seemed to help my skins texture overall. It reduces the oily appearance and leaves my skin smooth for make up. I don't think it's done much for hyper pigmentation but I've only had it for two weeks, so it's too soon to say. It's worth trying and see how it works for you! Then in the bad side well not so bad but it stings a little bit but its worth fighting thur it and seeing the end results.

To start off, yes I received this product as a free trial for a review. This Daily re-texturizing Triple Acid Peel is absolutely amazing! Instantly after using I saw the extra dirt this took off my face. On the 3rd day my face started to have a lovely glow to it after I would use the product plus feel so soft and clean. I would use this twice a day, once in the morning and before bed. Definitely getting more of this product and using in my routine.

I received Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel complimentary from Bzzagent and Kiehl's in exchange for my honest review. I am slowly becoming a full Kiehls convert and this product solidifies my opinion. The consistency of this peel is lightweight, smooth, and has improved my skin's texture, leaving it noticeably brighter after a few weeks of use. Paired with Kiehl's Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum, my fine lines have diminished noticeable especially in the horrible light of my bathroom. It's a must-try for anyone looking to improve their skin's appearance.

Thank you so much to Kiehl's Since 1851 for providing this free Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum in exchange for an honest review! As a 40 year old construction worker, my skin care routine was pretty much non-existent. I was nervous at first because this was my first time using retinol but I didn't have any adverse reaction to it whatsoever. My pores look smaller and my skin feels smoother. After using this product for about a month, I can definitely say this will become a staple for me!

I've been using this product most nights for the past 3-4 weeks since receiving it in exchange for my honest review. I found that it did not irritate my skin, and my skin seems more radiant than before I started using it. Overall, I really like this product!

avis.titre: This is the secret to glass skin!
avis.texte: I got this product as part of a campaign for my honest review from bzzagent. I want to start off by saying how much I'm loving this! My skin feels smoother, my pores are decreased in size and my acne flare ups no longer exist! This product is an acid so I used it slowly and worked my way up to be able to use it daily. I use it now daily every morning after I shower and cleanse my face. Compared to other acids I've tried I feel like this has the perfect mixture of everything so that it's not too irritating but does the job. It's become a staple in my routine and I cannot recommend this enough!

I have somewhat sensitive dry skin so I am nervous to use peels. This product pleasantly surprised me. It did not have a harsh scent and did not cause my skin to react negatively. My skin felt much smoother and softer after use.

avis.titre: My skin is much less congested
avis.texte: This product is the real deal! I have dealt with horrible acne most of my life and while it's mostly calmed down, I still right really congested skin. No red flares, but lots of closed and open comedones (whiteheads and blackheads). Within a day of starting this, I noticed brighter skin, within a week I noticed a reduction in my skin's congested appearance. My skin looked smoother, brighter, and wore makeup better. I like the dropper for dispensing product, and I love that I can't see through the bottle so I know when I'm running out. Overall, love this skin product and I would buy more in a heartbeat.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I have combination skin with occasional breakouts and hyperpigmentation. I recently tried this product I applied the acid peel once a week, leaving it on for about 5 minutes before rinsing it off with cool water. Initially, I experienced a slight tingling sensation, but it was bearable and subsided quickly. After the first use, I noticed my skin looked brighter and smoother. Over several weeks of consistent use, I saw significant improvements in my acne scars and overall skin texture. However, I did experience some dryness, especially around my nose and cheeks, which I managed by using a hydrating moisturizer afterwards. Compared to other acid peels I've used, this stood out for its effectiveness in brightening my skin without causing excessive irritation. I would highly recommend it to anyone dealing with dullness or mild pigmentation issues. Overall, I rate this Acid Peel 4.5 stars out of 5 for its noticeable results and gentle yet effective formula. Remember to patch test before full application and use sunscreen daily while using this product. I hope this review helps! Happy skincare journey!
Love the packaging. This peel is amazing. Doesn't smell like old lady. I'm going to continue to buy this!
I use it as a serum layer, use after clean and before moisturizer. This contains AHA, PHA and BHA. This helps to brighten and boost radiance of your skin. I can see the result after 2 weeks of use

I love love this! My skin is sensitive so I have to be careful of the products I use. I have been using this 2-3 times a week and I love how the texture of my skin feels. It's gentle and makes my skin look amazing!
I suffer with super sensitive and dry skin. My skin had never felt so good after using a product.

So I started using this product in the morning only once a day and did notice minor changes within the first week of use. I have very wrinkly under eyes and this product genuinely made my skin look so hydrated and even. I usually wear makeup for work on the weekends and ever since this product my makeup doesn't crease by my eyes anymore. I do can say the first 2 days I broke out a little from slightly purging but after it went away my skin seemed flawless. I would definitely recommend trying this product out slowly once a day and gradually moving up to a morning and nighttime routine. Don't worry if you purge a little it's normal

Why wasn't this around sooner?!! I use it every night before bed after removing my make up from the day. In the morning I follow up with my morning Kiehl's retinol and daily moisturizer. I can see a noticeable difference from the peel.

I really have been enjoying Kiehl's Clearly Corrective™ Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel. It is lightweight and smooth on the skin. It doesn't break me out. It leaves my skin feeling bright and radiant. There is no smell. I have texture on my forehead and it seems to definitely improved since using this product. I use this product with the Kiehl's Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide. This combo has been wonderful for my skin.

avis.titre: Leaves a nice texture to my skin with little irritation!
avis.texte: I have combo to oily sensitive skin with larger pores. I used this product once a week, and had little issues. It left my skin feeling smoother the next day. I've worked up to twice a week, and it works even better. It says it can be used daily, but see how your skin reacts before going straight to that schedule. It reduces the oily appearance and leaves my skin smooth for make up. I don't think it's done much for hyper pigmentation but I've only had it for two weeks, so it's too soon to say. It's worth trying and see how it works for you!

Thanks Kiehl's for my free product. I tried this product for the last week. I used it as a duo with the retinol. I found this product gentle enough not to aggravate my skin, and I liked that it gave me a fresh appearance.

I uses this product just as the directions stated. I used the cotton rounds to apply it. I will say o was skeptical at first anything with the words acid and peel always make me a little nervous. But this product is very gentle! It didn't cause me any adverse reactions. Left my skin feeling very soft. It also seemed to help my skins texture overall. Thank you to Kiehl's for sending me this in exchange for my honest review!

avis.titre: I would switch to this product for sure
avis.texte: I am 50 years old and always had great skin when I was younger but I'm seeing the effects of age now. The Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel has helped my skin to show less texture and look more radiant. It is gentle on my skin and my skin does not turn red or feel irritated at all like with some other acid products. I will keep using this and I'm looking forward to seeing the results over the long-term. I would definitely recommend to a friend.

After cleansing my face I put half a dropper onto cotton pad and apply to face. I wait for it to dry and then follow with kiehls Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptides, followed by my moisturizer. I love the way it leaves my skin feeling and looking. I feel as though my skin looks rejuvenated and radiant! I received both products in exchange for a review and I'm so glad to have received them! I have already repurchased them (as they were on sale). I intend to use this for a long time.

I've been using this product in combination with the micro dose retinol daily and I haven't had any irritation. It doesn't give me in any dry, peeling patches that I have experienced with other acids in the past, Those were probably too high in percentage for my skin. I would definitely recommend for anyone with sensitive skin looking for a gentle acid serum.
I use it first thing after cleansing my face. Let it dry then use any serum of your choice. It definitely helped with texture on my oily skin.
I've never used a peel before, but I found it made my skin clearer. No harsh scent, easy to use, not burning, or irritating.

I've been using this for about 2 weeks now and it works great! I've noticed my skin is smoother and brighter. I've even received compliments on my skin from family and friends. Most products don't do what they say in this short amount of time. I will be using this from now on.

avis.titre: Possibly Helping, Start slow off you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin is a little sensitive. If you do, you migh want to use tjis once a day or every other day and increase slowly over time. I have been using the Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel and the Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide twice a day. I appreciate these free sample. After about a week and a half my skin seemed a bit smoother and I had not had any irritation. After a couple more days, my skin became irritated. After a little break, I plan to just use one in the morning and the other at night and skip using either once a week. I am hopeful that with longer term use I will see more results since the active ingredients have been shown effective in skin care.

Kiehl's is a brand I trust as I have used a few of their products over the years. This one is a game changer! It goes on smoothly, not sticky, zero smell and goes a long way. I have been using it for a few weeks and I can see and feel the difference in the smoothness of my skin. Thank you Kiehl's for another great product!
I received this sample for review purposes. This helps my skin look clear and hydrated. I apply it after I clean my face and use my toner.
My skin feels amazing after this peel, so soft. The peel was easy to use and can be added into a weekly routine. I would recommend this.

This clearly corrective daily acid peel is a must have in your daily skincare routine. Am in love with the result a get from using this peel. My skin is definitely more brighter and smooth than before. 10/10 would recommend to all
I would definitely buy this product again :) I have sensitive skin and it cleared up my hormonal breakouts.

Thank you @bzzagent @kiehls I'm so happy that I was able to try this product for free. I absolutely love the way my skin is looking after 3 weeks of using this. I recommend starting out a bit slower with this than using it twice a day. It's stronger than you would think. I did have some purging of my skin but I needed it. I get hormonal acne and I could feel pimples trying to come through on my chin and my forehead but they just wouldn't fully come to a head. With this serum, it brought them to a head and it didn't make the acne worse. I will definitely be adding this to my skincare routine

I received a free sample of Kiehl's Clearly Corrective™ Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel from BzzAgent to try and review. I am 53 years old and was not happy with the dull and tired looking appearance of my skin. I've tried many products in the past, but none of them have helped. Immediately after trying this product I noticed that my skin color was much brighter. After 3 weeks of use the over all feel and elasticity of my skin has improved significantly. This product has already taken 5 years off the appearance of my skin!

A peel has always been intimidating to me. I've been afraid of burning, redness, irritation etc… this product is fantastic. My skin feels younger and I dare say it looks younger. My makeup works better… an all around improvement to my daily look. I am able to wear less makeup which has always been my preference.
I've seen a big improvement in my skin in a couple of weeks of use. It feels smoother and looks brighter. I'm excited to get another bottle.
it feels so dewy and leaves my skin so nice!! my skin is literally like glass after using this!
Thanks BzzAgent for sending me this product to try and review! Have been using for a couple weeks and my skin seems to be smoother already.
This is a great peel for the price. I love the texture and also the feel on my skin. After your skin feels soft smooth and the next day its even better! A must try!

Nothing clears up my skin faster than AHA, so I was excited to try this! It's just as gentle as it promises to be and works pretty much overnight! I was dealing with some breakouts and one use of this had me clearer the next day. My skin is definitely smoother, though I'm sure it'll take awhile to see less of my fine lines. I can't believe I can use it every day and am excited to see faster results because of this. I started trying it on my hands yesterday and am hoping for some improvement of sun spots. My hands are already smoother and softer! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
I've applied this product on a freshly washed face every other night for a week. I've noticed my skin is smoother and brighter. I've even received compliments on my skin from colleagues!

I received this product for free in exchange for a review. In a short time, this has already done wonders to brighten up my face and reduce the appearance of pores. I naturally have very dry skin and it isn't drying at all. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Smooth and Radiant Skin Everyday? I want!
avis.texte: I typically shy away from buying peels because my skin is sensitive and I always get a tingling sensation with peels. The Kiehl's peel is the exception. My skin absorbs this quickly and it feels so nice.I used my moisturizer and SPF afterwards and have seen my skin change within two weeks of using the product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I have used this brand a few times in the past. I never LOVED the products I tried. This smoothing peel, however, does just that. I have recently been obsessing over trying to achieve a fresh, young, clean skin appearance. This product does the trick. I use it on clean skin as the first step. It's not greasy at all. I don't notice any scent from the product and it wears nicely under my daily makeup.

avis.titre: Smoother Skin and Reduced Fine Lines..
avis.texte: I was so excited to be able to try this product.. After a couple days, my skin looked brighter, smoother and more even.. After a week, I noticed disappearance in my fine lines.. I have received so many compliments on how my skin looks younger and refreshed.. This product has made a major improvement on my skin.. I promise you won't be disappointed.. (I received the product for free in exchange for writing this honest review)

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I was very happy with the quality and effectiveness of this product. There is virtually no scent; it absorbed into my skin really well and hasn't caused any redness or irritation thus far. It removed the dead skin without any burning or itching and helped to reduce the visibility of my pores and gave me a more even skin tone. A little bit also goes a long way with this product, so it's a really great value for the quality. Overall, this left my skin feeling clean and smooth and left me with a more hydrated look. I'd definitely recommend giving this product a try!

I have very sensitive skin and retinol and salicylic acid products seemed to bother my skin in the past. I had not tried Kiehl's before though. I started using it once a day in the evening after washing my face. It can be used twice a day but because of my sensitive skin I chose to begin with once a day. I chose evening because of the sun warning and I began using the Kiehls skin renewing daily micro dose serum in the morning. I am very impressed so far with this product.
